message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 19 cards each + 8 special cards) | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play all cards in a single round). | | **Setup** | Shuffle → Deal 7 cards to each player → Place remaining cards face‑down as draw pile; flip top card to start discard pile. | | **Turn Actions** | 1️⃣ Play a matching card (color or number) or a special card.
2️⃣ If you cannot play, draw one card from the draw pile.
3️⃣ If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips a turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses next color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn (must be played only if no other playable card exists). | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, they earn points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Scoring** | • Number cards = face value.
• Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **End Game** | First player to reach 500 points wins the game. | **Key Rules & Tips** | Rule | Explanation | |------|-------------| | **Matching** | A card can be played if it matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard. | | **Wild Cards** | Can be played at any time; the player declares the new color. | | **Wild Draw Four** | Must be used only when the player has no legal card to play. If challenged and found to have a playable card, the challenger draws four cards instead. | | **Drawing** | If you draw a playable card, you may play it immediately. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before your opponent takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty (draw two cards). | | **Penalty for Wrong UNO Call** | If you call “UNO” incorrectly (e.g., when you still have more than one card), you must draw two cards. | | **Game Variations** | Many house rules exist (e.g., “Stacking” where players stack Draw Twos). Clarify before starting. | **How to Score a Round** 1. Add up the point values of all cards left in opponents’ hands. 2. The winner of the round receives those points. **Example** If Player A wins a round and the remaining cards in opponents’ hands total 120 points, Player A scores 120 points. --- **Quick Reference Cheat Sheet** | Card | Value | Effect | |------|-------|--------| | 0–9 | Face value | Normal play | | Skip | 20 | Next player loses a turn | | Reverse | 20 | Reverses play direction | | Draw Two | 20 | Next player draws two cards and skips a turn | | Wild | 50 | Choose next color | | Wild Draw Four | 50 | Choose next color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn | Enjoy playing Uno!
